roles.title: Senior Product Manager
roles.location: Primary: Bay Area (San Francisco/Peninsula) | Secondary: NYC

bullets: Own the product lifecycle for a specific feature area of the app (to be assigned based on team needs) from opportunity sizing and requirements through launch and post-launch…
Write and maintain product requirements, acceptance criteria, and gap analyses that hold up under real engineering and QA scrutiny not just slide decks.
Partner daily with engineering leads and designers in tight iteration loops; be in the details of the build, not just the roadmap.
Use AI tools as a default part of how you work from drafting specs and synthesizing research to prototyping flows and querying data so your output is materially faster than a…
Bring an AI-first product lens to the roadmap itself: identify where AI can improve the member experience (personalization, matchmaking, moderation, content generation, support)…
